description: This file provides a set of shell functions and environment variable configurations for managing services using start-stop-daemon, including actions like start, stop, check, reload, and signaling processes. It acts as a wrapper to standard service control commands in a Linux environment.

methods.name: service
methods.description: Main function to control service actions (start, stop, check, reload, signal) with configurable options and environment variables.

methods.name: service_check
methods.description: Checks if the specified service process is alive.

methods.name: service_signal
methods.description: Sends a signal to the specified service process, defaulting to USR1.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the specified service process, with retries and escalation to kill if necessary.

methods.name: service_reload
methods.description: Reloads the specified service process by sending a reload signal.
